items.1: The patch adds one branch to decide() and changes no other function.
items.2: No import, no new file and no command are added.
items.3: Only tools/lane_guard.py is touched; nothing outside it is written.
items.4: No credential or token appears anywhere in the patch.
items.5: The new branch returns before any confirmed result is built, so it cannot be bypassed by a later return.
items.6: Nothing is repeated or retried; the branch is straight-line.
items.7: decide() reads only the finding it is handed, which the caller already supplied.
items.8: No lock, reservation or temporary directory is taken, so there is nothing to release on an error path.
items.9: candidate publication is covered by the decisions entry below.
items.10: N/A: no control_results came with this candidate, so no row was proved for it and there is no host result to echo.

decisions.allow_refuse: The branch refuses a finding the host did not record and confirms one it did; both halves are in the patch.
decisions.not_found: A finding with no verification key at all is refused by the check above the branch, not read as absent.
decisions.permission_denied: decide() opens no file, so no read can be denied; the proof atom that reads the row refuses it.
decisions.link_loop: No path is opened here, so a loop cannot be reached; the proof refuses a row or switched file that is a link.
decisions.not_directory: Not reachable in this function; it takes no path.
decisions.other_io: Not reachable in this function; it performs no I/O.
decisions.parse_error: The caller refuses a body that is not one JSON document before decide() runs.
decisions.timeout: This function cannot block: no I/O, no wait, no loop.
decisions.empty_result: An empty claim is refused by _text(), so an empty finding never reaches the new branch.
